# Construction Company Website

> A licensed and insured general contractor offering commercial, residential, and industrial construction services.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, featured projects, and company introduction.
- [About](/about): Company history, mission, and team.
- [Services](/services): Full list of construction services offered.
- [Projects](/projects): Portfolio of completed commercial, residential, and industrial projects.
- [Blog](/blog): Company news, project spotlights, and industry insights.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact form, phone, email, and office address.
